method: Retain original data rows B=P Phi, data target b=P x and R. Let T=L_R^-T. Observation-dual augmented least squares min_u ||T*B*u||^2+||u-b||^2 yields q=T T* B* u. This is the same stationary representer q=R^-1 Phi* w, w=P*u; it avoids explicitly applying H^-1 or squared normal matrices. Observation-row variable is larger than waveform variable: no reduced-cost claim.
